subject: MedStream: privacy addendum redline + evidence handoff
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana.park@medstream.co>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medstream.co
Date: 2027-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Privacy addendum + SOC2 evidence for onboarding

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has requested we get a signed processing addendum in place before we move to a pilot. Attached is our initial redline of your standard privacy addendum (file: MedStream_Privacy_Addendum_v0.2_redline.docx). High-level asks from my side:

- Can Redwood accept the requested limitation on data retention for pilot logs (90 days) and confirm deletion semantics?
- We need written confirmation about whether Redwood will act as a processor or co-processor for PHI during the pilot. This will determine HIPAA scoping.
- Please provide your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and evidence mapping to the CAIQ/SIG questions where available.

Procurement would ideally have the redline reviewed and routed for signature this week. I realize legal may need more time; please let us know an internal owner and ETA.

Appreciate it —
Dana Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
MedStream Health
[Attachment: MedStream_Privacy_Addendum_v0.2_redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@medstream.co>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy addendum + SOC2 evidence for onboarding

Dana —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Logan (privacy) so we can get the right stakeholders on the thread. 

Quick responses:
- Internal owner: Neha Kapoor (our Legal Ops counsel) will lead the redline review and follow up on retention/HIPAA scope. I’ve asked Neha to propose edits or compromises where possible.
- SOC2 and CAIQ mapping: we can provide the SOC2 Type II attestation and a CAIQ mapping extract; I’ll ask Marissa to attach evidence.

Can you share the name/email for your legal counsel who will execute the final DPA, and confirm whether the pilot will involve PHI (even if just limited fields)? That will help us finalize the processor role.

Goal: come back with a consolidated Redwood redline + evidence bundle within 72 hours. Is that acceptable for your timeline?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 415 555 0192

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@medstream.co>, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-20T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Privacy addendum + SOC2 evidence for onboarding

Dana / Jasmine —

Thanks for the redline. I reviewed MedStream's proposed edits and attached a consolidated Redwood redline (see attached: MedStream_Privacy_Addendum_v0.2_redline.docx — we tracked our comments). Key points from Legal: 

1) Retention: We can agree to limit pilot log retention to 90 days for customer-specific diagnostic logs. However, our platform retains aggregated telemetry and certain security logs for up to 12 months to meet operational and security requirements. We propose: customer-specific pilot logs = 90 days (confirmable and deletable on request); aggregated telemetry = anonymized and retained up to 12 months.

2) HIPAA / PHI: Based on the pilot description you sent, Redwood will act as a Processor. That said, if you plan to send PHI-containing datasets, we will need a Business Associate Addendum (BAA). Please confirm whether PHI will be transmitted; if yes, procurement/legal should request a BAA and we’ll route that in parallel.

3) SCCs and international transfers: We include SCCs as part of our standard DPA; I attached a mapping doc (SCCs_Mapping_MedStream.pdf) showing clauses that cover transfer mechanisms. If you’re routing via EU data flows, please flag and we’ll escalate to Privacy for review.

4) Security evidence: SOC2 Type II is available; I have included the attestation stub and can provide a controlled copy upon execution of an NDA or via a secure SharePoint link.

Next steps I propose:
- Redwood to produce a clean redline with suggested compromises (attached).
- MedStream legal to confirm PHI/no-PHI and provide execution contact.
- If PHI is in-scope, procure BAA concurrently.

I’ll hold changes that would be material to liability/indemnity until we hear back on PHI.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Legal Counsel, Contracts & Privacy | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: SOC2_Type2_Attestation_2026.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@medstream.co>
To: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Dana Park <dana.park@medstream.co>, procurement@medstream.co
Date: 2027-03-22T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy addendum + SOC2 evidence for onboarding

Neha / Jasmine —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifying points from MedStream Legal/InfoSec: 

- The pilot will include limited PHI (patient initials + appointment timestamps + short clinician notes). We therefore need either a BAA or explicit processor assurances in the DPA. Please advise timeline to surface a BAA draft.

- SOC2: we need the full report (not just stub) and an evidence mapping to the CAIQ v4 control IDs related to encryption (both at rest and in transit) and key management. Specifically, confirm whether customer-managed keys (CMK) are available for pilot encryption of stored artifacts.

- Retention: the 90-day pilot logs is acceptable, but we need an automated delete API or documented manual deletion runbook and proof of deletion upon request.

Procurement asked we have an executable DPA by 2027-03-26 to keep the pilot slot in the April calendar. Can Redwood meet that date if we escalate the BAA in parallel?

Thanks,
Evan Zhou
Counsel, Legal Operations | MedStream Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@medstream.co>, Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@medstream.co>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-25T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy addendum + SOC2 evidence for onboarding — next steps and signature link

Dana / Evan —

Thanks for the confirmation, and glad we captured the PHI scope early. Short summary and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth:

1) PHI: MedStream confirmed limited PHI in pilot. Redwood will provide a BAA template and route signature in parallel with the DPA redline. Neha: can you please attach the BAA draft to the Docusign envelope?

2) Retention: Redwood confirms customer-specific pilot logs will be deleted at 90 days. We will provide a one-time deletion report on request and are working on an automated deletion API (ETA Q3 2027).

3) Encryption/CMK: For the pilot we can support platform-managed keys. Customer-managed keys are part of our Dedicated offering; we can discuss a pilot carve-out if needed but it will add ~2 weeks for key onboarding.

4) Evidence: Attached are the SOC2 Type II attestation PDF and SCCs mapping doc. For the full SOC2 report we can provide an access-controlled copy post-NDA/execution.

5) Timeline: Neha and I propose to finalize the DPA + BAA redlines and send a DocuSign envelope by EOD 2027-03-25 to meet your 2027-03-26 target for signature. Please confirm the signing contact for DocuSign (we will set the sig order with MedStream legal first).

DocuSign link (preview): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123456789
Shared evidence folder: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/medstream-evidence-2027

Let us know the signer and we’ll route. Thanks again — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Attestation_2026.pdf, SCCs_Mapping_MedStream.pdf]
